representation_paths.memory_component: persistent 3D scene information for spatially consistent video generation

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Diffusion latent tokens tied to world-space coordinates in a persistent 3D cache. queries the persistent cache by projecting latent-attributed 3D points onto target camera grids with z-buffering and ControlNet-style injection.

Initialize-readout-update loop persists static scene information across chunks; generated frames can update the latent cache; no self-improving policy. For Latent Spatial Memory, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of persistent 3D scene information for spatially consistent video generation.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (persistent 3D scene information for spatially consistent video generation) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
